name: EV-R1 'How much do I owe' routes to account servicing
description: Routing: a balance question routes silently to account-servicing, with verification before any figures. Customer: Ava Thompson (CUST-1001).

instructions.conversation_prompt: The balance intent was routed to account servicing without narrating any skill switch, identity was verified before any account figure was spoken, and both answers ($1,843.27 balance, $10,156.73 available credit) match the tool output exactly.

turns.user_message: How much do I owe on my card?
turns.expected_output: Agent routes this to account servicing (switches to the account-servicing skill) and begins identity verification before giving any figures. The switch must be silent — the agent must not mention skills, routing, transfers, or 'switching'.
turns.reference_response: I can check that for you. First let me verify your identity — what's the phone number on your account?

turns.expected_output: Agent asks for the verification PIN.
Agent calls verify-identity, then answers the original question with the current balance of $1,843.27 from account-get-overview (or immediately proceeds to look it up).
turns.reference_response: You're verified, Ava. Your current balance is $1,843.27.

turns.user_message: And how much credit do I have left?
turns.expected_output: Agent states the available credit of $10,156.73 (mentioning the $12,000 limit is a plus) using account-get-overview data. It does not invent figures or re-verify the customer.
turns.reference_response: You have $10,156.73 in available credit out of your $12,000 limit.

agent_notes: Phone matched a Meridian customer. Ask for the 4-digit verification PIN.
Never read the PIN back to the caller.
Identity verified for Ava. Proceed with the customer's request.
Verification persists for the rest of the session, including across skill switches.
Speak amounts naturally (for voice). Autopay is enrolled for the statement balance.
No caller ID is available. Ask the customer for the phone number on their account, then call verify-identity again with it.
